jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description – **Social Media Manager (Contract Basis)**

**Position:** Social Media Manager

**Employment Type:** Contract Basis

**Organization:** Vaarahi Eco Industries

About Vaarahi Eco Industries

Vaarahi Eco Industries is committed to promoting sustainable living through innovative, eco\-friendly products and awareness campaigns. Our mission is to encourage environmentally responsible practices through impactful products, community engagement, and digital outreach.

Position Overview

We are looking for a creative, result\-oriented, and highly motivated **Social Media Manager** to strengthen our digital presence through **organic content and community engagement**.

The ideal candidate should be passionate about storytelling, social media growth, influencer collaborations, and sustainability. This role focuses on building brand awareness through **organic reach rather than paid advertising**.

Key ResponsibilitiesSocial Media Management

* Manage and maintain the company's Instagram and Facebook accounts.
* Plan, create, schedule, and publish daily content.
* Design and publish engaging posts, stories, reels, and short\-form videos.
* Develop content calendars aligned with brand campaigns and seasonal events.

Content Creation

* Create high\-quality Instagram reels to improve organic reach.
* Write compelling captions, hashtags, and content descriptions.
* Identify trending topics, audio, and content formats.
* Ensure all content reflects the company's brand identity and sustainability values.

Website and Blog Management

* Write, edit, and publish website blogs.
* Update website content regularly.
* Optimize blog content for search engines (SEO).
* Maintain consistency between website content and social media campaigns.

Influencer Outreach and Collaborations

* Identify and connect with influencers, creators, environmental advocates, celebrities, and community leaders.
* Develop collaboration opportunities to increase brand visibility.
* Manage communication, partnerships, and influencer relationships.
* Track collaboration performance and engagement.

Community Engagement

* Respond to comments, messages, and customer inquiries.
* Build an active online community.
* Increase follower engagement through organic interactions.

Analytics and Reporting

* Monitor social media performance.
* Track follower growth, engagement, reach, and content performance.
* Submit regular performance reports and recommendations.

Required Skills

* Experience managing Instagram and Facebook business accounts.
* Strong knowledge of Instagram Reels and organic growth strategies.
* Excellent content writing and communication skills.
* Experience with influencer outreach and collaboration.
* Basic knowledge of SEO and blog writing.
* Familiarity with content creation and graphic design tools.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience in social media management.
* Experience working with eco\-friendly, sustainability, lifestyle, or consumer brands.
* Knowledge of video editing tools and content creation platforms.

Important Note

* **This position focuses exclusively on organic growth.**
* **Paid advertising and ad campaign management are not part of this role.**

Contract Terms

* Contract\-based position.
* Compensation: As per experience and performance.
* Work mode: Remote/Hybrid (as applicable).
* Performance will be evaluated based on content quality, engagement, collaborations, and organic growth.

Pay: ₹11,353\.63 \- ₹43,169\.64 per month

Benefits:

* Internet reimbursement

Application Question(s):

* Are you a experienced Reel editor ?

Can you create uniform posts for our brand as per algorithm 

* Have you achieved any milestones if yes please mention
* How many views and likes your posts got ? Please mention links of viral posts if any

Experience:

* Reels editing and posting : 1 year (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

*Own the why, and shape what gets built.*


**About the Role**
------------------



We build products for clients, and someone has to own the problem: what we're solving, for whom, and why it matters. As a Lead Product Manager, you lead discovery, set product direction, and turn fuzzy business needs into something the team can actually build. You are the person keeping everyone pointed at the outcome that matters.



You'll work inside a Monks delivery team as a trusted advisor to our clients and the primary product point of contact, partnering closely with engineering and design.



We're all\-in on agentic engineering. Tools like Claude Code and Codex are part of our everyday workflow, and we're looking for people who are genuinely fluent working alongside AI coding agents and excited to push those practices further.


**Who You Are**
---------------


* **A trusted advisor:** clients rely on your judgment, and you earn it.
* **Decisive under ambiguity:** you make the call with incomplete information and adjust as you learn.
* **User\- and business\-minded:** you hold both the customer's need and the client's goals at once.
* **A clear communicator:** you deliver concise, decision\-ready updates to any audience.

**What You'll Do**
------------------


* **Discovery and strategy:** run discovery, research, and analysis, and define the product direction and roadmap.
* **Client partnership:** serve as trusted advisor and primary product contact, surface competing needs early, and broker trade\-offs.
* **Delivery:** define requirements, prioritize, and manage scope with engineering and design from idea through launch and adoption.
* **Measurement:** define the KPIs that matter and use data to drive iteration.
* **Risk:** spot risks to delivery early and drive mitigation.

**What You Bring**
------------------


* 5\+ years in product management for software or digital products, ideally including 0\-to\-1 work.
* A track record leading end\-to\-end discovery and turning operational needs into scalable requirements.
* Strong stakeholder facilitation and negotiation skills.
* Comfort with web technologies, technical concepts, and APIs.
* Ability to ramp quickly on an unfamiliar domain.
* Goal\-oriented, autonomous, and organized.
* Strong English communication skills.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced, agile consulting environment.

**Extra Credit**
----------------


* A consulting or client\-facing background.
* Experience shipping AI\-powered products.
* Agile certification (e.g. CSPO).
* Experience mentoring other product managers.
* Fluency with collaborative tools (Figma, Miro, Jira, or similar).


\#LI\-PP1  

\#LI\-Remote

Monks is the global, digital\-first, data\-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high\-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long\-term impact.

  



Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022\-25\) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger's Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020\-24\). As a trusted partner to cutting\-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025\), runner\-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024\), and Workato's AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024\). Additionally, Monks achieved a record\-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

### **Lead Generation \& Conversion Optimization**

* Monitor lead quality and analyze MQL SQL Opportunity Customer conversion.
* Work closely with Sales and Business Development teams to improve lead quality and conversion.

* Build and optimize workflows for lead routing, reporting, alerts, campaign monitoring, data synchronization, and marketing operations.

* Reporting: Looker Studio, Power BI, Advanced Excel/Google Sheets

### **Good to Have**

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field

**About The Role**
 We’re building a travel platform spanning
 **Flights, Hotels, and Experiences** 
 for one of the largest telecom operators in Europe. The product brings together multiple travel partners and integrates deeply with the telecom’s loyalty ecosystem to create a seamless booking experience for millions of users.
   

  

 We’re looking for an
 **Associate Product Manager / Product Manager** 
 who is excited by the challenge of building products from the ground up. You’ll work across the entire product lifecycle—from identifying customer problems and defining solutions to launching features, measuring their impact, and continuously improving the experience.
   

  

 This role doesn’t end at launch. Once the product is live, you will work closely with users, analyze data, identify opportunities, and drive product\-led growth initiatives that improve conversion, engagement, retention, and customer satisfaction. You’ll play a key role in shaping the product into one that customers love and one that delivers meaningful business outcomes.
   

  

 If you’re someone who enjoys solving customer problems, making data\-driven decisions, and taking ownership from idea to impact, you’ll thrive in this role.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Help build and scale the Flights, Hotels, and Experiences product from the ground up.
* Own product initiatives from discovery and problem definition through launch and post\-launch optimization.
* Work closely with engineering, design, business, and external partners to deliver high\-quality product experiences.
* Translate customer problems and business opportunities into clear product requirements and PRDs.
* Define priorities, manage execution, and ensure timely delivery of product initiatives.
* Analyze user behavior, funnel metrics, customer feedback, and business performance to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Design, prioritize, and execute product\-led growth initiatives to improve acquisition, conversion, engagement, repeat usage, and retention.
* Run experiments, measure outcomes, and iterate rapidly based on customer insights and data.
* Coordinate with integration partners to ensure reliable and scalable customer experiences.
* Continuously refine the product based on user feedback, analytics, and evolving business needs.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 2 to 4 years of product management experience building consumer or marketplace products.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with data to drive product decisions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to simplify complex problems into intuitive customer experiences.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with ambiguity.
* Curiosity to understand customers, technology, and business—not just feature requirements.

**The Opportunity**

* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This role is part of a broader enterprise initiative to establish a
 **Data Context Layer (DCL)** 
 — a foundational capability designed to provide consistent, reusable, and scalable context across enterprise data products.
   

  

 The DCL is intended to address challenges related to
 **data fragmentation, lack of shared semantics, and inconsistent interpretation of data across systems and products** 
 . It establishes a unified layer for representing context, relationships, and meaning, enabling downstream products to operate with greater consistency, interoperability, and intelligence.
   

  

 In addition, the DCL plays a critical role in enabling
 **agentic AI capabilities across the enterprise** 
 by providing the structured context and semantic grounding required for intelligent agents to operate reliably. This includes ensuring that agent\-driven workflows and decisions are based on
 **consistent, governed, and interpretable data context** 
 , reducing risks associated with fragmentation, ambiguity, and lack of control.
   

  

 Within this initiative, the Associate Director – Product Manager, Context Serving. will own the
 **product definition, development, and evolution of core context serving capabilities** 
 . These capabilities form the backbone for how context is consumed across multiple products and platforms, and will be central to enabling
 **governed, scalable, and reusable intelligent systems** 
 .
   

  

 The role operates at the intersection of
 **product, architecture, and enterprise platforms** 
 , working closely with Enterprise Architecture, platform teams, and product leadership to build
 **enterprise\-grade context capabilities that support both traditional data products and emerging AI\-driven use cases** 
 .
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a Product Manager to own a single, high\-impact capability within our enterprise data context platform
 **self\-service serving of standardized data context** 
 . This role will focus on defining, building, and scaling one core capability that enables teams to publish, discover, and consume data context consistently across the enterprise.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has strong product instincts, technical fluency in data/semantic systems, and experience partnering with engineering and architecture teams to deliver a platform capability from definition through production adoption. This role also requires working knowledge of
 **agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering** 
 concepts, particularly as they relate to delivering reliable, reusable context for AI\-enabled applications.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the product vision, requirements, and roadmap for the assigned capability within the context platform.
* Define how the capability supports standardized, self\-service serving of data context.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, and governance teams to translate standards into implementable product requirements.
* Ensure the capability is intuitive for users and scalable for enterprise adoption.
* Define workflows for
+ publishing context
+ discovering context
+ consuming context through approved interfaces
+ validating and maintaining context quality

* Collaborate with adjacent platform teams to ensure the capability integrates cleanly with broader context, metadata, and governance services.
* Work with stakeholders to prioritize features, resolve tradeoffs, and drive adoption.
* Define success metrics such as usage, reuse, quality, and time\-to\-onboard.
* Support the transition of the capability from development into production, including release readiness, documentation, and operational requirements.
* Help shape how the capability supports agentic AI workflows, including reliable context delivery for prompts, tools, skills, and AI assistants.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of product management experience in technical products, data platforms, or enterprise software.
* Ability to work closely with engineering teams on platform or infrastructure capabilities.
* Familiarity with data context, metadata, ontology, or semantic concepts.
* Working knowledge of agentic AI, prompt engineering, and context engineering concepts.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience defining requirements for self\-service or platform capabilities.

jobs.description:
Job Summary
  
This hybrid role seeks a Product Test Specialist with five to seven years of experience in testing complex health care payer and provider solutions built on Facets and TriZetto Elements platforms. The specialist will validate enrollment benefits claims provider and CAE configurations to ensure accurate and reliable administration for payer and provider clients and support high quality member outcomes.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Perform end to end testing of Facets enrollment benefit configuration claims provider and CAE modules to ensure that payer and provider processes function accurately and consistently across releases.
  
Design detailed test scenarios and test cases based on business requirements for enrollment benefits claims and provider functions to confirm that each configuration behaves as expected for diverse member and provider segments.
  
Execute functional regression and integration tests on Facets and TriZetto Elements solutions to detect defects early and reduce production incidents for payer and provider customers.
  
Coordinate closely with business analysts and configuration teams to interpret complex payer and provider rules and translate them into clear test coverage for enrollment and benefits workflows.
  
Validate claims processing scenarios for various product designs and benefit structures to ensure correct adjudication results for different payer plans and provider contracts.
  
Review and verify provider data setup for networks contracts and participation details to confirm that claims routing and pricing logic aligns with payer policies.
  
Use CAE tools to analyze configuration effectiveness and identify test gaps so that enrollment and benefit changes are accurately reflected in member and provider transactions.
  
Document test results defects and configuration issues in a structured manner to support efficient triage root cause analysis and timely resolution by development and configuration teams.
  
Collaborate in a hybrid work model by joining virtual and in office sessions with cross functional teams to clarify requirements and align on test scope for each release.
  
Contribute to continuous improvement by suggesting enhancements to test coverage reusable test assets and automation candidates that increase efficiency and reduce cycle time.
  
Support user acceptance testing by guiding business stakeholders through test scenarios for payer and provider functions and by addressing questions on configuration behavior.
  
Analyze production issues related to enrollment benefits provider data and claims and replicate them in lower environments to validate fixes and prevent recurrence.
  
Prepare clear test summary reports and metrics that highlight risk areas configuration gaps and quality trends so that stakeholders can make informed release decisions.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Demonstrate five to seven years of focused experience in testing Facets modules including enrollment benefit configuration claims provider and CAE in large payer environments.
  
Apply deep hands on expertise in TriZetto Elements and Facets configuration testing to validate complex benefit designs and network structures for payer and provider clients.
  
Exhibit strong understanding of health care payer and provider domains including enrollment life cycle benefit administration provider network management and claims adjudication concepts.
  
Utilize advanced test design techniques and defect management practices to ensure thorough coverage and timely closure of issues in Facets and related components.
  
Communicate effectively in hybrid settings with product owners configuration analysts and quality teams to clarify expectations and share clear test findings.
  
Adapt quickly to evolving payer regulations product changes and system upgrades while maintaining high quality standards in all test activities for day shift operations.

**iOS Engineer – Universal Components**
---------------------------------------

  


### **About the Role**



Our vision is to free everyone to safely use any technology. We promise to make identity work for everyone—whether you’re a developer looking to innovate or a security professional looking to mitigate. We are looking for curious, excited, boundary\-pushing team members. So, if you’re a big thinker who is nimble and adaptable, Okta may be an ideal place to shine.



Okta’s Customer Identity Cloud (CIC), powered by Auth0 technology, is an easy\-to\-implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers. We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier 0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.



We are looking for a collaborative, developer\-focused **SDE2 iOS Engineer** to join our **Universal Components** team.

  


### **Job Description**


**You UNDERSTAND developers!** You know what they need, how to talk to them, how to make their lives easier, and what turns friction into delight. You recognize when a framework, library, or product provides an exceptional developer experience.



As an iOS Engineer on the Universal Components team, you will leverage that developer\-first mindset to build and maintain our open\-source UI components and SDKs. You will contribute to refining our entire developer journey—from onboarding, quickstarts, and documentation to providing direct assistance in developer channels. Your contributions will directly reach thousands of customer applications and carry a high impact across the mobile ecosystem.



You will act as an internal and external advocate for the iOS platforms and technologies you work with daily. Collaborating in a cross\-functional environment alongside developer relations, onboarding, growth, dashboard, and core SDK teams, you will help deliver a world\-class experience for our component libraries.



The most vital qualifications for this position are solid software engineering fundamentals, strong empathy for developers, and a collaborative mindset.

* **Building Modular UI:** Designing and developing composable, high\-quality UI components from the ground up using SwiftUI.

* **Code Quality \& Domain Expertise:** Serving as a key technical contributor by providing domain knowledge, participating in code reviews, and upholding quality standards across our iOS projects.
* **Knowledge Sharing:** Representing the team's technical expertise at developer events, community forums, or through technical blog posts.
* **Maintenance \& Modernization:** Troubleshooting, fixing, and maintaining client libraries while staying up to date with modern Apple frameworks and platforms.

### **What You’ll Bring to the Role**


* **3\+ years** of professional experience in native iOS development.
* **2\+ years** of hands\-on experience building production interfaces in SwiftUI.
* Ability to seamlessly translate design mocks (e.g., Figma) into clean, modular, and accessible SwiftUI code.
* A strong interest in developing reusable iOS libraries and SDKs consumed by third\-party developers.
* Solid understanding of modern iOS frameworks, Swift best practices, and the broader Apple ecosystem.
* Experience building or contributing to at least one shipped iOS application or public SDK using SwiftUI.
* Practical understanding of modern dependency managers and SDK distribution methods (e.g., Swift Package Manager, Carthage).
* Familiarity with CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitHub Actions, CircleCI) and running automated mobile tests in continuous integration pipelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a proven track record of authoring developer documentation or technical content.
* A collaborative approach to engineering, with the ability to self\-direct and execute independently while thriving in a globally distributed team.

### **Bonus Points If You Have**


* **Knowledge or hands\-on experience with Design Systems** (building component libraries, design tokens, or multi\-platform visual consistency).
* Hands\-on experience with **UIKit** and handling hybrid SwiftUI/UIKit architectures.
* Experience working in remote or distributed team environments.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Amazon Delivery and Shopping Experience Product Team is looking for a talented Sr. Business Intelligence Engineer who develop solutions to optimize customer experience by disproportionately improving discoverability and speed. As part of Amazon’s DEX product team, we have the opportunity to be at the forefront of DEX product thought leadership \- working on some of the most difficult Customer Experience problems while partnering with research scientists, software developers, and business leaders. With the focus on driving real impact on Amazon's long\-term profitability, we build new analysis from ground up, proposing new concepts and technology to meet business needs. We need strong BIEs who enjoy and excel at diving into data, analyzing root causes, defining long\-term solutions and driving their implementation with stakeholders.  

  

This position requires superior analytical thinkers, able to quickly approach large ambiguous problems and apply your technical and engineering expertise to rapidly prototype and deliver solutions. This skill also requires you to work across a variety of teams, including software tech teams, operations, finance, category, search, and inventory platform (software) teams. Successful candidates must thrive in fast\-paced environments which encourage collaborative and creative problem solving, be able to measure and estimate risks, constructively critique peer research, extract and manipulate data across various data marts, and align research focuses on Amazon’s strategic needs.  

  

We are NOT a reporting team and we are not looking for reporting analysts. We are looking for people with a flair for recognizing trends and patterns while correlating it to the business problem at hand. If you have an uncanny ability to decipher the exact policy/mechanism/solution to address the challenge and ability to influence people using hard data (and some tact) then we are looking for you!  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Sr. BIE in the team, you will work closely with program managers, software developers, research scientists, and product managers to analyze massive data sets, identify areas to improve, define metrics to measure and monitor programs, and most importantly work with different stakeholders to drive improvements over time. You will also work closely with internal business teams to extract or mine information from our existing systems to create new analysis, and expose data from our group to wider teams in intuitive ways. As a BIE embedded in the product team you have the opportunity to participate and shape product development as well as leverage your technical skills. This position provides opportunities to influence high visibility/high impact areas in the organization.  

  

A day in the life  

* You will perform complex data analysis (root cause deep dives, correlations, regressions, simulations, optimization) to identify different opportunities to improve sales, improve Prime shipping and delivery benefits, reduce ship costs, improve discoverability, etc.
* You will own end\-to\-end program management. You will not only develop insights but devise realistic plans and work with key stakeholders (software managers, product managers, retail business managers, sellers, transportation planners/managers, and warehouse managers ) to execute them.
* You will be responsible for adding YY million $ to top line or reducing XX million $ actual savings on the bottom line. You will not be responsible for only "recommendation" but actual improvements made to bottom or top line.
* You will engage with senior leadership on drafting proposals for new concepts, improvement plans, 3\-year strategy and outlook.
* You will be a subject matter expert in best in class customer experience policies at Amazon. You will understand intricate details of our promise and ordering systems along with their impact on ground\-level operations

  

About the team  

As Amazon International Emerging Stores’ DEX product team, we are at the forefront of the Customer Experience product thought leadership \- working on some of the most difficult Customer Experience problems while partnering with research scientists, software developers, and business leaders. With the focus on driving real impact on Amazon's long\-term profitability, we build new analysis from ground up, proposing new concepts and technology to meet business needs, and translating these concepts into robust scalable products that deliver tangible value to our customers and to the A.in business.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8\+ years of SQL experience
* Experience programming to extract, transform and clean large (multi\-TB) data sets
* 7\+ years of professional or military experience
* Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
* Experience with theory and practice of design of experiments and statistical analysis of results
* Experience with theory and practice of information retrieval, data science, machine learning and data mining
* Experience with AWS technologies

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience using Cloud Storage and Computing technologies such as AWS Redshift, S3, Hadoop, etc.
* Experience with statistical analytics and programming languages such as R, Python, Ruby, etc.

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. **About SpotDraft**
 SpotDraft is on a mission to help legal and business teams move faster, together. Our AI\-powered contracting platform is redefining how companies manage contracts, and our story deserves to be told in creative, human, and memorable ways.
   

  

**Top Outcomes:**
 This role sits in the core workflow legal and business teams use every day to get a contract from draft to signature: collaborative editing and redlining, negotiating with counterparties, routing for approval, and signing. It’s one of the highest\-usage parts of the product, used by nearly every customer on nearly every contract, and it doesn’t have a single owner today.
   

  

 Scope is flexible and will be shaped around the person we hire, calibrated to their experience during the process rather than fixed in this posting. Part of the job either way is imposing a single prioritised roadmap on an area that today gets pulled in different directions by different stakeholders, rather than treating each piece in isolation.
   

  

**Day to Day:**
* Own discovery for your area. Run customer and prospect conversations every week, and turn what you learn into a clear view of who you're building for and why it matters to them.
* Make evidence\-based calls. Instrument what you ship, state your confidence level upfront, and track whether you were right so your judgment keeps improving.
* Partner through the build, not just at kickoff. Work with engineering and design end to end, and give everyone a release affects, support, sales, whoever’s downstream, a real briefing instead of a surprise.
* De\-risk before you build. Test your riskiest assumptions before you commit engineering time to them.
* Prioritise ruthlessly. Keep one ranked backlog sized against real customer demand, and be ready to defend the business case and trade\-off behind every roadmap call.
* Ship iteratively. Deliver a working increment every sprint, each one tied to a real outcome or a learning.


**What Success Looks Like**
* A clear, prioritised roadmap for the area you own, with an explicit plan for how scope grows from there.
* Measurable reduction in time and friction from “ready to negotiate” to “signed” within your area.
* Issues resolved through the product, not through a standing support escalation queue.


**Requirements:**
* Product management experience owning a feature or workflow end to end to a measurable outcome. Years of experience matter less than the scope you’ve handled: tell us what you’ve owned and we’ll calibrate the role to it.
* Comfortable working in a high\-usage, multi\-stakeholder area where prioritisation itself is a core skill, not just execution.
* Background in document collaboration, e\-signature, contract/legal tech, or workflow automation products is a strong plus.
* Comfortable ramping quickly in a legal or contract\-heavy domain if you don’t already have that background.


**Nice to have**
* Prior experience in a regulated domain where explainability/audit was a hard requirement rather than a nice\-to\-have.
* Exposure to agent\-action protocols (e.g., MCP) or policy\-engine design for agentic systems.


**Why SpotDraft?**
* Brilliant teammates—Work with some of the sharpest minds in legal tech.
* Expand your network—Interact with top founders, investors, and industry leaders.
* Real impact—Take ownership of projects and see your work in action.
* Big goals, bold moves—We trust you to deliver, innovate, and push boundaries.


**Our Core Values**
* Our business is to delight Customers
* Be Transparent. Be Direct
* Be Audacious
* Outcomes over everything else
* Elevate each other
* Be Passionate. Take Ownership.
* Be 1% better every day

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
   

  

 Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever\-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

The role serves as a subject matter expert for delivery teams and acts as a key partner for stakeholders across business, technology, governance, and leadership.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Company** 





 Dentira is one of the fastest\-growing, profitable healthcare startups that is revolutionizing clinic operations across multiple countries. Our flagship product transformed dental procurement by introducing the world’s first real\-time price and product comparison engine for dental supplies in the US, Canada, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. Building on this success, our latest innovation, the Lab Platform, streamlines case creation and management by seamlessly connecting clinics, intraoral scanners, and dental labs. We are also pioneering the use of advanced AI technologies to tackle complex challenges like Automatic Invoice Reconciliation, procedure cost prediction etc that can be applied across various healthcare verticals that we cater to. 
 





 As we continue to expand, we are actively exploring adjacent verticals and new avenues for growth while strengthening our presence in existing ones. Our ambitious goal is to achieve over 10X growth within the next 3 years. 
 




  





**About the Role** 





 Dentira's marketplace connects clinics with the dental supply vendors who sell on our platform. As Senior Product Manager for the Vendor Success team, you will  empower our vendors to thrive on our platform. You will own the entire product experience for our vendors — from onboarding through day\-to\-day operations to their long\-term growth on Dentira. You'll define the strategy and roadmap for one of our most critical user segments, partnering with Account Management, Operations, and Sales across our global markets.
 




  






 This is an individual\-contributor role, ideal for someone who's energized by B2B/marketplace products, comfortable owning a roadmap end\-to\-end, and motivated by building tools that directly deliver P\&L impact. Join us as we continue to redefine the healthcare operations landscape.
 




  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for vendor onboarding, operations, and growth, translating market and vendor needs into a prioritized plan.
* Lead your product area's full lifecycle — from opportunity discovery and PRDs through launch, GTM, and post\-launch iteration.
* Be customer obsessed. Be the voice of the vendor internally: bring data, usability research, and direct vendor feedback into every major product decision.
* Partner effectively with global cross\-functional teams — Account Management, Operations, Design and Engineering — to ship vendor\-facing tools that are intuitive, scalable, and reliable.
* Build and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap across teams to effectively address market and vendor needs.
* Define clear goals and KPIs for your product area. Drive measurement discipline to build hypothesis and measure impact rigorously for your products
* Maintain clear, consistent product documentation (PRDs, prototypes, release notes) so stakeholders always know what's shipping and why.
* Represent your roadmap and results in executive reviews and cross\-functional forums.



  





  





**Basic Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's degree with a strong academic background.
* 4\+ years of product management experience, including shipping both 0\-to\-1 and scaled products, with a track record of taking a product from early traction to broad adoption.
* Customer obsession \- understand key seller pain points based on data, usability sessions and effective user research
* Strong data fluency — comfortable pulling and interpreting data independently to inform and defend product decisions.
* Execution Rigor: Experience owning the full product lifecycle: vision → roadmap → launch → GTM.
* Experience working cross\-functionally (Engineering, Design, Program Management, Finance, Marketing) in a global, decentralized organization.
* High ownership and a bias for action — Bring a Go\-getter mindset. You’ll do whatever you need to make your product and team successful .
* Structured thinking \- Ability to bring structure in a high complexity/ambiguity setup.
* Influence without authority \- Ability to inspire and rally a cross\-functional team around a clear vision, strategy and execution
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail.
* High EQ and a track record of building trust with both internal teams and external stakeholders (e.g., vendors, partners).



  





  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience building seller/vendor\-facing tools in a multi\-sided marketplace or B2B ecosystem
* Experience in healthcare, dental, or supply\-chain/procurement marketplace or regulated industries
* Experience working across global teams in the US, Canada, Europe, Australia, and India.
* Experience designing or shipping AI and agentic features in enterprise grade products.
* Track record of shipping successful software products with a significant impact on the user experience and business. 0\-1 experience is a plus.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving cross\-functional alignment in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated long\-term thinking around strategic and business\-focused goals.

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** 

 Founding Product Manager
 




**Location:** 

 On\-site, Bengaluru
 




**Employment Type:** 

 Full\-Time
 




  





**About LH2 AI Labs** 





 Built by second\-time founders who have built and sold companies before, LH2 AI Labs is building the post\-training infrastructure for frontier AI models.
 





 We bring private, high\-quality institutional datasets and vetted domain experts into frontier AI pipelines across verticals such as coding, computer use, agentic workflows, medical, audio, and more.
 





 For AI to keep progressing, it needs high\-quality training data drawn from real production use cases. The public web has already been crawled and trained on—there is limited new signal left there. That is where we come in.
 





 Our vision is to create a world where frontier models can access high\-quality data on tap, the same way they access computers today.
 




  





**Mission** 





 Own LH2's raw\-data\-to\-delivery product — the buyer\-facing platform that takes private institutional data from ingestion through to a finished, sellable product frontier labs can browse, sample, and license. Think AfterQuery\-style data storefront, built on our pipeline.
 




  





**What you'll do** 



* Own the product roadmap for the data\-to\-delivery product: how raw institutional data becomes a clean, documented, machine\-trainable deliverable a lab can evaluate and take.
* Own the buyer\-facing surfaces as products — the data catalog/storefront, dataset listings, method/provenance cards, sample delivery, and access\-request/licensing flows.
* Be the voice of the buyer: talk to frontier labs and data\-buying teams, learn how they evaluate and consume datasets, and shape the product around how they actually buy.
* Define the packaging and format standards labs expect (dataset specs, provenance/rights documentation, sample structure) and make "sellable" a clear, met bar.
* Prioritize across verticals (coding, company ops, medical, and adjacencies) so the catalog ships depth, not scattered breadth.
* Own provenance, rights\-clearance, and privacy as first\-class product requirements — they're the trust the whole business rests on, and they're features, not compliance checkboxes.



  





**Must\-have skills** 



* 5\+ years in product, with real 0→1 ownership — you've defined and shipped a technical product, not just managed a backlog.
* Comfort with technical, data\-heavy, or ML/AI\-adjacent products; you can hold your own with researchers and engineers and translate between them and buyers.
* Strong customer\-discovery instinct — you get in front of sophisticated technical buyers and extract what they actually need.
* Ruthless prioritization and the judgment to say no; you keep a small team focused.
* Clear written thinking — specs, positioning, and roadmaps that a lab and an engineer both understand.





 ﻿
 





**Nice\-to\-have skills** 



* Experience in AI/ML data, developer tools, data infrastructure, or B2B data products.
* Understanding of the post\-training landscape (SFT, RLHF, evals, RL environments) and what frontier labs buy.
* Experience packaging and selling to technical/enterprise buyers.

 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
 



  





 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
 



  





 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
 



  





 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @
 
 Rippling.com
 
 addresses.

 The product team owns Rippling’s product direction, defining what to build in order to solve customer problems in a way that allows them to succeed. We do this by intimately understanding the market, our customers, and the perspectives of our key stakeholders and synthesizing that into a product that is effective, efficient, and easy to use.
 



  





 In this role, you will be responsible for owning the success of the Rippling product in India. You will build deep market knowledge and understanding of customer needs, and work closely with design, engineering, legal and compliance to build and with sales, implementation and support to launch and continuously improve the product.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s supporting our songwriters, ensuring we provide the right royalty data to global partners, or helping our creative teams use the latest AI tools to discover new talent, technology plays an invaluable role in our success. Product Managers help turn vision into reality.
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Manager to partner with a local in\-person engineering team in Bengaluru focused on music distribution. Distribution is the vital link between music creation and a fan’s headphones, ensuring our music reaches platforms like Spotify and YouTube globally while protecting the complex rights that ensure our artists get paid. You will be a "user\-first" thinker who is responsible for a portfolio of features and products, navigating the high\-stakes world of global rights, supply chain automation, and high\-scale digital delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Continuous Discovery: Build deep empathy for our labels, operations teams, and global partners by maintaining a constant dialogue with them. Uncover their underlying pain points, ensuring that every solution we build truly solves their problems and makes their daily workflows more seamless.
* Strategy \& Roadmap: Define and communicate the long\-term vision and roadmap for your products, ensuring they align with WMG’s broader tech strategy.
* Product Trio Collaboration: Work in a "Product Trio" alongside Engineering and Design to solve complex problems, resolving trade\-offs and tackling risks.
* Execution \& Ownership: Serve as the primary author of PRDs and the "executor\-in\-chief" for your projects, driving development from ideation through technical delivery.
* Launch \& Impact: Develop comprehensive go\-to\-market strategies, including product positioning, internal messaging, and launch plans. You don't just "ship" code; you ensure the organization is ready to adopt it to achieve maximum impact.
* Analytical Optimization: Continuously monitor product performance metrics, user feedback, and market trends. Use this data to make informed prioritization decisions, identify areas for improvement, and manage technical debt to optimize the product over its entire lifecycle.


**Who You Are**
* Experienced: You have at least 5 years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to the music business or other digital media.
* Technical \& Business Savvy: You can discuss system architecture with engineers and business constraints with executives, mitigating Value, Usability, Feasibility, and Business Viability risks upfront.
* A Master Storyteller: You own the "Why" and can easily adjust your communication style for different audiences, from developers to more senior stakeholders.
* Biased to Action: You have a proven ability to unstick a team, make difficult prioritization decisions, and navigate the ambiguity of a global business.
* Humble Leader: You have strong opinions, held weakly; you are quick to share credit with your team and accept responsibility when things don’t go as planned.
* Mission\-Driven: You are a music fan motivated by the fact that your work directly impacts an artist’s ability to grow their career and get paid.

jobs.title: Technical Scrum Master
jobs.description:
**Req ID:** 386147
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Technical Scrum Master to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).
  
  

1 \| Position Overview
  
  

The Technical Scrum Master will lead agile delivery for the AWS Policy Master engineering pod and serve as the execution bridge among product owners, business and policy SMEs, solution architecture, data engineering, API, database, DevSecOps, and quality teams. The role combines strong Scrum facilitation with sufficient AWS and data\-engineering fluency to manage technical dependencies, remove impediments, maintain delivery transparency, and drive predictable releases across the S3–Lambda–SQS–Aurora–API flow. The individual will not act as the solution architect, but must be comfortable challenging plans, surfacing delivery risk, and translating technical progress into business\-ready status.
  
  

2 \| Required Skills and Experience
  
  

* 8–10 years of overall technology delivery experience, including at least 4 years as a Scrum Master or agile delivery lead for data, cloud, integration, or application\-modernization teams.
* Strong working knowledge of Scrum and Kanban practices, sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, velocity, capacity, and dependency management.
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams spanning cloud data pipelines, APIs or microservices, database engineering, DevSecOps, automation testing, and production support.
* Practical understanding of AWS delivery concepts—S3, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL, API Gateway, IAM, CloudWatch, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code—to facilitate informed technical planning and risk discussions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross\-team dependencies, RAID items, critical paths, nonfunctional requirements, environment readiness, testing gates, and release or cutover activities.
* Hands\-on experience with Jira and Confluence or equivalent agile lifecycle tools; ability to create actionable dashboards and concise executive status reports.
* Strong facilitation, conflict\-resolution, stakeholder\-management, written communication, and coaching skills; comfortable working across onsite and offshore teams and multiple time zones.
* Experience in insurance, policy administration, operational data stores, data mastering, or regulated financial\-services programs is strongly preferred.
* Scrum certification such as CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, or PMI\-ACP is preferred; AWS Cloud Practitioner or similar foundational cloud certification is an advantage.


3 \| Duties
  
  

* Facilitate sprint ceremonies and ensure each sprint has clear objectives, prioritized stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, estimates, and accountable owners.
* Partner with the Product Owner and technical leads to maintain a healthy backlog covering ingestion, validation, buffering, transformation, canonical policy data, Aurora persistence, APIs, observability, security, and reliability.
* Build and maintain integrated sprint and release plans across AWS data engineering, Aurora data modeling, API engineering, DevSecOps, testing, business SMEs, and dependent source or consumer teams.
* Identify, track, and remove delivery impediments; escalate architecture, access, environment, data, security, vendor, or dependency blockers with clear impact and resolution dates.
* Monitor sprint predictability, throughput, carryover, defect trends, test progress, technical debt, and release readiness; convert metrics into practical corrective actions rather than administrative reporting.
* Coordinate technical design reviews, story readiness, definition\-of\-done adherence, nonfunctional requirement coverage, test evidence, production\-readiness reviews, and go/no\-go checkpoints.
* Facilitate decision\-making and conflict resolution while preserving clear accountability among the Product Owner, architects, engineering leads, and business stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, root\-cause follow\-up, dependency reduction, automation opportunities, and consistent agile engineering practices.
* Provide concise weekly status covering accomplishments, upcoming milestones, risks, decisions, dependencies, staffing, and any impact to scope, schedule, quality, or cost.
* Support cutover, hypercare, incident triage, and post\-release reviews to ensure operational learning is incorporated into subsequent sprints.

jobs.title: Lead Specialist, Technology Solutions - Agentic Automations
jobs.description:
**About Pearson**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: **Add life to a lifetime of learning.**

As a global leader in digital learning, we are transforming how people learn through innovative, AI\-powered experiences that improve outcomes and create meaningful impact. Pearson is embracing a digital\-first future where AI, automation, and intelligent systems enable employees to focus on higher\-value work while accelerating business transformation.


The **Office of the CTO** powers this transformation by delivering scalable, secure, resilient, and intelligent enterprise platforms. Within Digital \& Technology (D\&T), the **AgentOps Team** leads the next generation of enterprise automation through Agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and autonomous systems that drive measurable business value.


**Why Join AgentOps?**

This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation and help shape how humans and AI agents collaborate at scale.


You will:


* Build cutting\-edge agentic AI solutions deployed across Pearson's global enterprise
* Create intelligent workflows that combine automation, reasoning, and human oversight
* Solve high\-impact business challenges using advanced AI technologies
* Influence enterprise\-wide AI engineering and automation standards
* Help define the future of a symbiotic workforce where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly

**Role Overview**

The **Lead Specialist, Agentic Automations** is a senior practitioner and solution leader responsible for driving the end\-to\-end discovery, design, and delivery of enterprise\-scale Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions.


This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, process transformation, and AI engineering. You will work closely with business leaders, architects, engineers, and product teams to identify automation opportunities, design scalable agent ecosystems, and deliver solutions that generate measurable business outcomes.


As a critical member of AgentOps, you will translate complex business challenges into intelligent, AI\-powered workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, risk, compliance, and ROI objectives.


You will play a key role in advancing Pearson's vision of an AI\-enabled enterprise powered by agentic systems and intelligent automation.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Analysis \& Opportunity Discovery**

* Lead end\-to\-end requirements gathering, process discovery, and stakeholder workshops for agentic automation initiatives.
* Analyze business processes to identify opportunities for intelligent automation, autonomous agents, and AI\-driven workflow transformation.
* Facilitate cross\-functional discussions with SMEs, product owners, operational teams, and business leaders.
* Document and validate business requirements, use cases, process maps, and success criteria.

Technical Product Owner – Supply Chain Systems Dyson IT: At Dyson, we demand the highest standard of performance from the technologies we engineer. Our people expect the same from the technology that supports them. We are a community that appreciates and advocates better engineering. A community of pioneers. The aim of Dyson IT is to create robust IT architecture, to manage data and processes effectively and efficiently and continue to grow our world\-class team. A team who is strategic, enabling business acceleration, growth, and success. Dyson’s Global IT – Group Support Functions has end\-to\-end accountability for the strategic roadmap, design, delivery, and support of all business applications enabling Dysons global planning, procurement, manufacturing, supply chain, aftersales, finance, HR and legal business processes. Forming a significant proportion of the IT Function, the team is arranged into business and technology\-focused domains:
   

  

* Global Supply Chain (including Planning \& Mfg as well as Core Supply Chain Logistics)
* Finance Systems
* HR Systems
* Legal Systems About the Role: Reporting to the Senior IT Product Manager, Supply Chain Systems, you will be responsible for the technical ownership, roadmap, architecture governance, and operational performance of SAP Supply Chain platforms and applications. This role will act as the bridge between business stakeholders, architects, delivery teams, AMS partners, and software vendors to ensure SAP solutions continue to meet Dyson's evolving business needs. You will be accountable for maintaining a secure, scalable, and reliable SAP landscape while driving continuous improvement, technical modernization, and business value realization across Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, Warehousing, and Supply Chain execution processes. The role is responsible for:
* Own and manage the SAP Supply Chain technology roadmap, ensuring alignment with business strategy, platform architecture, and product priorities.
* Act as the technical authority for SAP Supply Chain applications, providing leadership on solution design, integration architecture, platform capabilities, and technology direction.
* Provide functional and technical expertise across SAP Supply Chain modules including S/4HANA, MM, SD, EWM and related planning solutions.
* Collaborate with Business Product Owners and stakeholders to translate business priorities into a technical platform roadmap.
* Lead discovery workshops and requirements gathering sessions with global business stakeholders.
* Analyse business processes and identify opportunities for process optimisation, automation, standardisation, and simplification.
* Produce high\-quality artefacts including BRDs, user stories, process maps, use cases, functional specifications, and requirements traceability matrices.
* Work closely with business and IT stakeholders to understand business changes, challenges, and opportunities, and translate them into clear solution requirements.
* Perform gap analysis, impact assessments, and solution evaluations across business processes, systems, integrations, data, and reporting.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Architects, Developers, and QA teams to define and deliver end\-to\-end solutions.
* Support prioritisation and management of business requirements, ensuring alignment with business objectives and product roadmaps.
* Provide functional expertise across Supply Chain Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Warehousing, Logistics, and related business processes.
* Support the review and validation of solution designs to ensure business requirements are fully addressed.
* Drive the identification, prioritization, and remediation of technical debt, platform risks, and architecture improvements.
* Support delivery teams throughout project lifecycles by providing technical leadership, architecture review, and design governance.
* Ensure compliance with Dyson security standards, governance processes, and architecture principles.
* Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Infrastructure, and Integration teams to ensure end\-to\-end solution integrity.
* Define and manage platform lifecycle activities, including upgrades, patches, releases, and technology refresh initiatives.
* Coordinate major platform changes and service upgrades with business stakeholders, vendors, and support teams.
* Produce and maintain platform resiliency plans, including Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Planning (BCP).
* Establish and monitor platform health, service KPIs, system performance, and operational metrics.
* Support delivery teams throughout project lifecycles by providing technical leadership, architecture review, and design governance.
* Review and approve solution designs, technical specifications, and integration approaches.
* Manage technical relationships with software vendors, system integrators, and AMS partners.
* Ensure successful transition of projects into production support through robust service transition and knowledge transfer processes.
* Partner with QA teams to support testing strategy, defect management, business validation, and production readiness.
* Manage platform\-related risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations across global programmes.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to SAP analysts, developers, and delivery teams. About You: You should possess strong SAP Supply Chain domain expertise and technical leadership capabilities, with the ability to engage effectively with senior business stakeholders and technical teams. You will have experience managing enterprise\-scale SAP landscapes and driving strategic technology decisions in a global organization. You must demonstrate strong leadership qualities and be able to operate effectively across geographically dispersed teams in a matrix\-managed environment. Core Competencies:
* Strong technical leadership with the ability to define and govern SAP platform strategy …

jobs.title: Product Owner II
jobs.description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**PRODUCT OWNER**
**Position Summary**
 We are seeking experienced Product Owners to help deliver on our product objectives and roadmaps. Product Owners are responsible for delivering product outcomes and functionality that meet customer and user needs. They translate product vision and insights into prioritized features and user stories, developed by their agile team of 8–10 members.
   

  

 This role collaborates with Candescent clients and Product Managers to identify and prioritize requirements for enhancements to the Banking Platform. Product Owners also work with the Product Advisory Council, participating in user group discussions and presenting both strategic and tactical functionality. Additional responsibilities include release planning, product roadmap maintenance, and backlog grooming for assigned Candescent Banking Services initiatives.
   

  

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
* Lead efforts to define specific functions, integration requirements, user experiences, and deployment strategies for delivery to both the company and market
* Develop, shape, and refine user stories, problem statements, and acceptance criteria to ensure efficient and effective team consumption
* Collaborate with the broader product organization to ensure integration across all Candescent Digital Banking Technology products
* Work closely with the development team to ensure that delivered products meet specified requirements and are delivered on time and within budget
* Drive understanding of the work to be completed by the development team, supporting effective sprint sequencing and incremental delivery
* Participate actively in scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, daily stand\-ups, and demos
* Maintain functional quality by setting and evaluating expectations and acceptance criteria
* Present and train internal customers on new platform features and services released in each version
* Prepare explanatory documentation for customers on existing and new platform functionality
* Document business requirements using the company's software development tools and methodology


**Product P\&L and Pricing**
* Collaborate with the Product Manager to manage product profitability and performance, ensuring alignment with short\- and long\-term product objectives and roadmaps


**Product Strategy, Vision, and Planning**
* Gather customer and user needs, along with market research, to inform the product vision and strategy created by the Product Manager
* Use the product vision and insights to define product features and prioritize the team’s backlog


**Customer Experience Research, Insights, And Execution**
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of customers and users through the development of insights, including personas, journey maps, and product charters


**Product Design and Development**
* Participate in PI (Program Increment) planning to prioritize the roadmap and inform team backlogs
* Write and prioritize user stories based on business needs, user requirements, and technical feasibility
* Continuously refine the product backlog by analyzing value versus effort
* Define acceptance criteria and validate that features and stories meet user quality standards
* Drive product development in collaboration with cross\-functional teams and engage stakeholders (e.g., PMs, other POs, functions) to manage dependencies and resolve issues


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent work experience
* 5\+ years of experience in the finance industry, preferably with large\-scale digital, online, or mobile banking applications for consumers or small businesses
* Strong understanding of complex business and technical problems
* Proven experience delivering software products through the definition, design, and release cycle
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies throughout the software development lifecycle
* Familiarity with industry standards such as PCI, WCAG, and FFIEC
* Strong leadership, project management, time management, and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Deep understanding of user and business needs to create and prioritize user stories that deliver value
* Ability to prioritize based on business value, user impact, and technical feasibility


**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: HMI Scrum Manager
jobs.description:
**At Visteon, the work we do is both relevant and recognized—not just by our organization, but by our peers, by industry\-leading brands, and by millions of drivers around the world. That’s YOUR work.** 
**And, as a truly global technology leader in the mobility space, focused on building cross\-functional AND cross\-cultural teams, we connect you with people who help you grow.** 
**So here, whatever we do is not a job. It’s a mission. As a multi\-billion\-dollar leader of disruptive change in the industry, we are shaping the future, while enabling a cleaner environment. No other industry offers more fast\-paced change and opportunity. We are in the midst of a mobility revolution that will completely change the way we interact with our vehicles, reduce the number of car accidents and fatalities, and make the world a cleaner place.** 
**Visteon is at the epicenter of this mobility revolution.** 
**Two major trends in the automotive industry – the shift to electric vehicles and vehicles with autonomous safety technologies – have created unique opportunities for Visteon. We are the only automotive provider focused exclusively on cockpit electronics – the fastest\-growing segment in the industry.** 
****About the Role:****
**We are looking for a Product Owner to organize, prioritize and assess work for our scrum team.** 
**Product Owner responsibilities include gathering feature requests, scheduling releases and coordinating sprints aligning to program delivery timeline and other dependent domain releases. To be successful in this role, you should be able to identify user needs and work with cross\-functional teams to manage HMI deliverables. Product Owners have many day\-to\-day responsibilities, such as reviewing feature requests and determining which ones can be implemented in the next release, prioritizing backlog items for the development team, and creating product roadmaps for testing.** 
**Ultimately, you’ll help us roll\-out HMI deliverable for products that deliver our company’s vision.** 
****Responsibilities:****
* Incorporate feature requests into product roadmap
* Groom and prioritize backlog
* Develop user stories and define acceptance criteria
* Set sprint goals
* Write acceptance criteria
* Plan releases and upgrades for HMI work items
* Aligning the Pre\-Int testing with the planned deliverable.
* Follow progress of work and address production issues during sprints
* Analyze preferences and requests of program PO.
* Refine our agile methodology based on results and client feedback
* Keep track of industry trends, requirements and skills
* Work experience as a Product Owner or similar role in product management
* Familiarity with agile is a must.
* Hands\-on experience managing all stages of the product life cycle
* Technical background with knowledge of software development and web technologies
* Team spirit and good communication abilities
* Good organizational skills


****Nice to Have:****
* Knowledge of model\-based design
* Familiarity with automotive infotainment development.
* Experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
* Knowledge of automotive network management
* Android Programming Experience
* CAN Communication and Protocol
* HMI architecture knowledge


****Qualifications** 
 :**
* BSc in Computer Science, Engineering or similar field


****Behaviors(Preferred)****
* Functional Expert: Considered a thought leader on a subject
* Enthusiastic: Shows intense and eager enjoyment and interest
* Detail Oriented: Capable of carrying out a given task with all details necessary to get the task done well
* Dedicated: Devoted to a task or purpose with loyalty or integrity


**Ability to Make an Impact: Inspired to perform well by the ability to contribute to the success of a project or the organization** 
****More Good Reasons to Work for Visteon Focusing on the Future****
**Our company strategy focuses on leading the evolution of automotive digital cockpits and safety solutions. This strategy is driven by constant innovation, and you will support our efforts through your role. We are recognized across the industry for innovation. We have a strong book of business that is expected to drive future growth, along with a customer base that includes almost every automotive manufacturer in the world.** 
****Company Culture****
**Working at Visteon is a journey in which our employees can develop their strengths and advance their careers while making a difference globally. Join us and help change the world and how we interact with our vehicles. Visteon is where the best technical talent creates the future. Learn more about our culture here.** 
****About Visteon**
 Visteon is advancing mobility through innovative technology solutions that enable a software\-defined future. Our state\-of\-the\-art product portfolio merges digital cockpit innovations, advanced displays, AI\-enhanced software solutions, and integrated EV architecture solutions. With expertise spanning passenger vehicles, commercial transportation, and two\-wheelers, Visteon partners with global automakers to create safer, cleaner, and more connected journeys. Headquartered in Van Buren Township, Michigan, Visteon operates in 17 countries, employing a global network of innovation centers and manufacturing facilities. In 2024, we recorded annual sales of approximately $3\.87 billion and secured $6\.1 billion in new business.**

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Role Summary:\-**
 The Product Owner is responsible for managing complex business requirements, driving solution discussions, and ensuring successful delivery of product capabilities across domains and systems.
   

  

 The role requires strong product thinking, insurance domain expertise, and the ability to operate effectively in AI\-enabled delivery environments. The Product Owner is expected to leverage AI\-assisted workflows to improve speed, quality, traceability, prioritization, and cross\-functional collaboration.
   

  

 The Product Owner is a member of the Product Management team of IDIT R\&D, responsible for managing requirements for complex features in the system. The candidate should be able to run workshops with domain managers, Product Managers, and customers to elicit requirements, present solution designs, and take requirements through to implementation.
   

  

**Pre\-requisites**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT preferred) or equivalent qualification.
* MBA preferred.


**Experience**
* 6–9 years of relevant experience.
* Should have some technical experience before transitioning to a BA/Product role.
* Insurance or BFSI experience is a must.
* Prior knowledge of Core Insurance is a must.
* Experience of having worked in at least one implementation project.
* Led end\-to\-end requirements for at least 2 modules.


**Key Responsibilities**
**Product \& Requirement Ownership**
* Gather business requirements for medium to complex features and interfaces in the system (Contact/Policy, Claims/Accounting/Interfaces).
* Document requirements in SDS.
* Analyse and prioritize defects.
* Conduct requirement discussions with Product Managers, Domain Managers, and customers.
* Conduct walkthroughs of requirements with development and QA teams.
* Attend daily stand\-ups.
* Conduct User Forums.
* Conduct training sessions for junior members of the team.
* Work as a core representative to project teams as needed.
* Convert business requirements into Epics, Features, User Stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive end\-to\-end solution discussions across Product, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and Delivery teams.
* Perform impact analysis across modules, systems, and business processes.
* Prioritize backlog items aligned to business outcomes and roadmap objectives.
* Ensure traceability from business requirements to implementation and validation.
* Support product roadmap execution and release planning.


**AI\-Enabled Responsibilities**
* Use AI tools to accelerate requirement analysis, documentation, prioritization, and workshop preparation.
* Use AI\-assisted techniques for: story generation, acceptance criteria generation, process mapping, impact analysis, test scenario generation, SQL/query generation, knowledge retrieval, and defect analysis.
* Validate AI\-generated outputs for correctness, feasibility, traceability, hallucinations, and bias.
* Use AI\-enabled insights to improve delivery efficiency and decision\-making.
* Contribute reusable prompts, templates, and AI\-assisted delivery assets.
* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled ways of working within teams.
* Apply responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, privacy, and human oversight.


**Mandatory Skills**
* Strong understanding of insurance processes and core insurance systems.
* Experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Solution Design.
* Ability to manage complex cross\-functional requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies.
* Strong analytical and prioritization capabilities.
* Working knowledge of APIs, integrations, and enterprise systems.
* Excellent analytical skills and good design skills.
* Intermediate SQL and data modelling skills (mandatory).
* Understanding of SDLC and Agile concepts (mandatory).
* Very good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to document business requirements as user stories; break large epics into smaller features and stories and document them in SDS.
* Ability to conduct demos and walkthroughs with POs and business users.
* Techno\-functional and business solutioning capability.
* Ability to effectively leverage AI\-enabled delivery tools.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Experience with AI\-enabled delivery platforms and workflows.
* Exposure to prompt engineering and AI\-assisted analysis.
* Exposure to digital transformation initiatives.
* Exposure to Agentic AI concepts and orchestration\-based workflows.


**Key Characteristics**
* Outcome\-oriented mindset.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to balance speed with quality and governance.
* Systems thinking and cross\-domain understanding.
* Coaching and mentoring mindset.
